blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Self-Powered Nanotechnology Windows for Base Resilience and Integrated Security' — described only as a demonstrated solar-window product, not an installed base energy system
blind_spots.operator_reality: Connecting distributed energy-generation windows into a base's microgrid/SCADA requires an ATO for anything that touches base control networks — the company's public materials never mention this integration step, only the glass itself.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Company language treats the product as a drop-in commercial glazing material, not as an interconnected base-infrastructure system requiring its own authorization.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Self-Powered Nanotechnology Windows for Base Resilience and Integrated Security

blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Drop-in solutions for existing products' framing applied to base-installed window glazing
blind_spots.operator_reality: Physical installation on a military installation involves civil engineer sign-off, GFE coordination, and facility timelines that a B2B commercial materials pitch never accounts for — 'drop-in' assumes a retail supply chain, not base construction processes.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The B2B pitch language is written for industrial partners (greenhouse film manufacturers, solar panel makers), not for base facilities engineering.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Our business model prioritizes a B2B approach, integrating quantum dots as drop-in solutions for existing products.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Security inks are marketed as commercial anti-counterfeiting technology for 'high-value goods'
blind_spots.operator_reality: If DoD ever adopts this for supply-chain authentication (a real DoD interest), tagged items and their read data likely become CUI requiring ITAR/CMMC-level controlled handling — the company's public framing is purely commercial brand-protection, with no controlled-data posture visible.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The focus page groups Security Inks with Agriculture and Solar as parallel commercial applications, with identical B2B language for each.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Security Inks — Advanced anti-counterfeiting solutions for high-value goods.

opener_hook: Your 2022 Air Force release framed the base-resilience windows as post-demonstration, pre-deployment — what's actually standing between the demo glass and glass installed on a live base?
what_they_do: Manufactures quantum-dot nanomaterials sold B2B as drop-in components for greenhouse films, solar panels/windows, and security inks; a small Air Force SBIR line funds photovoltaic windows for military base energy resilience.
